name: openclaude-antigravity-provider
description: Local OpenAI-compatible proxy that authenticates via Google Antigravity OAuth. Enables OpenClaude to use Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3 Pro/Flash using your Google credentials with automatic multi-account rotation and rate-limit handling.

proxy_port.title: Proxy server port
proxy_port.description: The local port the Antigravity proxy listens on. Default: 51122. Change only if this port is already in use.

auto_start.title: Auto-start proxy on session start
auto_start.description: When on, the SessionStart hook automatically launches the proxy server in the background if it is not already running. Set to off/false/0/no to disable.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: The model to suggest when configuring OpenClaude's provider. One of: antigravity-claude-sonnet-4-6, antigravity-claude-opus-4-6-thinking, antigravity-gemini-3.1-pro, antigravity-gemini-3-flash.
